title: Create VLA contract and metric schema
objective: Create a documentation-only VLA/world-model contract and metric schema that reconciles the 8D left-arm action interface with the 14D dual-arm target interface and defines measurable dry-run evaluation fields.
context: task_0002 found that the project currently has a mismatch between an 8D practical left-arm absolute action path and a 14D guide-level dual-arm delta action contract. Before implementing any VLA, world model, critic, or evaluator code, the project needs a stable schema for observation, state, action, task, safety gate, world-model facts, failure taxonomy, and dry-run metrics.
steps: Validate this task with agent_guard.py before doing anything else.
Read only the declared read_only_files and this task JSON.
The schema document must define a VLA observation contract, including camera fields, state fields, task prompt fields, timestamps, and missing-data handling.
The schema document must compare the current 8D left-arm absolute action interface against the guide-level 14D dual-arm delta action interface.
The schema document must define a safe migration path from 8D dry-run validation to 14D dual-arm validation without live robot execution.
The schema document must define a world model fact table with robot_state, perception_state, task_state, safety_state, memory_state, and media_state.

The schema document must define critic/retry failure taxonomy categories: observation_missing, action_invalid, safety_gate_blocked, task_phase_mismatch, stale_plan, contact_or_grasp_uncertain, localization_unavailable, controller_not_ready.
The schema document must define measurable dry-run metrics using existing logs/artifacts only.
The schema document must include a minimum viable JSONL event schema for future VLA dry-run logs.
The schema document must include acceptance criteria for future task_0006.
Run the declared result_checker.py command after writing the result JSON.
Do not modify source code outside .ai_agents.
success_criteria: The document defines observation, state, action, task, safety, world-model, critic, and metric schemas.
The document explicitly reconciles 8D left-arm absolute action and 14D dual-arm delta action.
The document defines dry-run metrics that do not require live robot execution.
The document defines a future VLA dry-run JSONL event schema.
The document recommends a concrete low-risk task_0006.
No robot motion script, ROS driver, controller, dataset, checkpoint, rosbag, or secret is accessed.
No source code outside .ai_agents is modified.
stop_conditions: Any command attempts to launch a robot, ROS, controller, or motion script.
Any command attempts to modify source code outside .ai_agents.
Any command attempts to read secrets, datasets, checkpoints, or rosbags.
A command requires sudo or installs system packages.
A command attempts to start ROS drivers, hardware controllers, or actuator commands.
AI-B needs a shell command not listed in task.commands.
